data.title: Enova Mining Secures Option Over Brazilian Rare Earths Project and Raises Capital
data.description:
The latest announcement is out from Enova Mining Limited ( (AU:ENV) ).

Enova Mining Ltd has secured a low-cost exclusive option to acquire 100% of the Caraúbas Monazite Project in Paraíba, north-eastern Brazil, comprising nine granted exploration licences over 17,796 hectares in the Borborema Geological Province, a region regarded as highly prospective for rare earths. The company has mobilised its geology team and commenced comprehensive technical, legal, environmental and commercial due diligence to assess the project’s prospectivity and merits before deciding whether to exercise the option.

To support the proposed acquisition and future exploration, Enova has obtained binding commitments for a $1.5 million unbrokered placement and plans a non-renounceable rights issue to raise up to about $495,200, both priced at $0.001 per share. Completion of the deal remains subject to successful due diligence, shareholder approval and other conditions, after which Enova intends to undertake systematic exploration to define and prioritise targets, potentially strengthening its position in the rare earths sector and offering additional upside for investors.

data.title: Waratah Minerals Reports Strong Gold Recoveries at Consols Zone
data.description:
Battery Minerals Ltd. ( (AU:WTM) ) just unveiled an update.

Waratah Minerals has reported strong initial geometallurgical test results from the Consols Zone at its Spur Project in New South Wales. Early-stage diagnostic leaching and gravity tests on core samples show high overall gold recoveries of 89% to 93% using a combination of gravity separation and conventional leaching.

The studies confirm coarse, free-milling gold with grain sizes up to 601 microns, modest gravity recoveries and high leach recoveries, with negligible gold locked in silicates. These results mirror earlier work at the Spur Zone, indicating a simple, standard processing flowsheet and providing key data on gold deportment and grain size to guide further metallurgical optimisation and project development.
